story.title: DeepMind's David Silver raises $1.1B to build AI that learns without any human-generated data
story.summary: Ineffable Intelligence, founded by former DeepMind researcher David Silver — the architect of AlphaGo — has raised $1.1 billion in funding at a valuation of $5.1 billion just months after its founding. The lab is pursuing a fundamentally different approach to AI, building systems that learn entirely without human-generated training data. If successful, this would remove one of the core bottlenecks in modern AI development: the requirement for vast quantities of human-labelled or human-produced content.
